test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_text_index_lazy_substreams ( id UInt64, val UInt64, msg String, INDEX idx msg TYPE text(tokenizer = 'splitByNonAlpha') GRANULARITY 1 ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS index_granularity = 1024, min_bytes_for_wide_part = '1G', max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_text_index_lazy_substreams SELECT number, number, if(number BETWEEN 400000 AND 400004, 'rareneedle midtok extra', concat('midtok filler', toString(number % 97), ' tok', toString(number % 13))) FROM numbers(800000) SETTINGS max_block_size = 2000, max_insert_block_size = 2000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 0, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0
test.query: SELECT sum(val) FROM t_text_index_lazy_substreams WHERE hasToken(msg, 'rareneedle')
SELECT sum(val) FROM t_text_index_lazy_substreams WHERE hasToken(msg, 'midtok')
